$comment: V2 - reference-derived palette. PROVENANCE: reference/analysis (pixel sampling of 30 frames + MiMo color analyst, confidence per token in 'provenance'). SPEC: MASTER_SPEC 2.2.

gold.semantic: important semantic emphasis, key words, value, time

orange.semantic: selected environmental warmth (rare - brown-graded reference variant); use sparingly

background.base.source: reference pixel sampling (#0a1212 x10, #0b1212 x5 of 30 frames) + vision estimate #0b1313

background.deep.source: derived: darker companion of base for vignette edge

background.elevated.source: derived: elevated surface one step above base, same teal cast

background.warmVariant.source: reference frames with warm brown grade (unclear if palette or grade)

text.primary.source: vision estimate #f4f2ed; pixel samples (#b5b1a7..#cbbeb2) are downscaled/diluted

text.secondary.source: pixel samples of subtitle glyphs + vision estimate

accents.teal.value.source: vision: mint brand accent (#7fd1bd) on avatars/logo

accents.orange.value.source: MASTER_SPEC 2.2 warm environmental option; weak reference presence
